review_findings.title: Custom/imported pixel overlays are absent from native hit regions
review_findings.details: Reviewer evidence: readSpriteMask is derived from the base HTMLImageElement; AgentSprite renders custom pixel-document pixels as separate SVG rects, but Overlay passes only spriteMask plus label/thought bounds to buildInteractiveRegions. A custom visible pixel outside the base mask can be rendered yet click-through. Include custom visible pixels in the same deterministic region calculation and test it.
